author: codex

patch.value: Remove private identities and host-specific paths from reachable Git history

A full reachable-history audit is required before pm-graph may be considered safe for public publication. Any private identity, absolute host path, credential, or tenant data in reachable commits must be removed with an auditable history rewrite and fresh-clone verification.

Identity allowlist audit passes across every reachable ref; Secret and absolute-path scans pass across full history and packaged contents; PM history privacy validation passes without manual history edits; Fresh-clone evidence is recorded before publication approval
Audit every reachable commit and ref, PM history, tracked files, generated artifacts, and package tarball; verify from a fresh clone after any rewrite.
All reachable refs and packaged artifacts contain only approved public identities and portable paths, with no secrets, private service data, or host-specific values.
No current complete, exact reachable-history privacy attestation is recorded for the 2026.8.7 tranche.
Publishing before attestation could expose personal or private infrastructure data permanently.

patch.value: Maintainer-directed coordinated history rewrite executed 2026-08-22 under Steve's standing release-privacy directive, replicating the pmc-t8tj precedent (pm-changelog PR #149). Disposable mirror /tmp/pmgraph-rewrite.git rewritten with git-filter-repo: email callback mapped all three non-public identities (stefan@preu.at, dev@unbraind.com, noreply@unbraind.local) to 1153461+unbraind@users.noreply.github.com across authors/committers/taggers; blob callback replaced /home/steve with $HOME in every blob. Pre-rewrite audit reproduced exactly: 131 commits carried host-path lines in pm-graph-fq9w task/history files plus 22 hits in runtime metadata caches; six unique commit identities existed. Post-rewrite verification: 0 host-path blobs across ALL objects (batch-all-objects scan), identity set noreply-only (unbraind, github-actions[bot], dependabot[bot]), HEAD tree byte-identical (6ffad79), ref inventory unchanged. Force-push executed for all heads+tags via temporary admin protection lift, protection restored verbatim (test(22)/test(26), enforce_admins, conversation resolution). Fresh origin clone audit: all heads+tags clean, identities CLEAN, zero host-path objects. Residual risk documented: GitHub-managed refs/pull/* keep legacy objects fetchable by exact SHA until gc/support purge; normal clones never receive them.
